relations: Continuous milk pouring into the open neck gradually raises the liquid level and mixes the layers.
The initial separation of green liquid and white milk transitions into a uniform pale green mixture.
The persistent milk stream maintains flow into the bottle throughout the tighter framing transition.
caption: The video showcases a clear glass bottle with a white 'green tea milk' label on a pale marble-like surface, into whose open neck a thin stream of white milk pours from an unseen source above. The bottle holds dark green liquid at the bottom beneath white milk, and the layers remain largely separated as the pour continues. A handwritten-style caption reading '차가운 우유 440ml / Cold milk' sits at the left while a 'J / Dessert' logo stays fixed at the top right. That left caption drops out partway through, leaving the bottle against the bright backdrop. A translucent duplicate of the same bottle fades in offset to the upper right, an editing overlay rather than a second physical object. The view later transitions to a tighter framing centered on the label. Within this shifted view the contents read as a uniform pale green, and the milk stream at the neck keeps falling. The clip holds on this blended appearance with the stream still running, marking neither the pour's start nor its conclusion.
